about: The spellings of #[map(..)], #[schema(..)] and #[builder(..)] and what they mean, for coqui-builder's derive and guatiao's. Each case names an item (every {derive} is replaced by the derive under test) and what each derive does with it: "accept", {"refuse": "a stem of the message"} or "pending" (a spelling guatiao's derive has not learned yet). An accepted case may state `expect` (coqui-builder reads `coqui_expect` and `coqui_item` where a case has them, for its leaf descriptions and its text converters): kind, keys in order, required, defaults as JSON, descriptions, sensitive keys, choice names, tag and arms. `guatiao_item` replaces `item` for guatiao where a `with` module has to follow its contract. `compiles_alone: false` keeps a case out of coqui-builder's rendered meaning tests when its expansion names a type the case does not define.

cases.name: fields keep their names
cases.item: {derive} struct S { host: String, port: u16 }

cases.name: rename_all kebab-case
cases.item: {derive} #[map(rename_all = "kebab-case")] struct S { view_only: bool, max_len: u32 }

cases.name: a field's own rename wins over rename_all
cases.item: {derive} #[map(rename_all = "kebab-case")] struct S { #[map(rename = "Host")] host_name: String, max_len: u32 }

cases.name: a skipped field is not a key
cases.item: {derive} struct S { a: u8, #[map(skip)] b: u8 }

cases.name: a default makes a key optional
cases.item: {derive} struct S { #[map(default)] n: u32, #[map(default = 5)] m: u32, #[schema(default = 7)] k: u32 }

cases.name: an Option is not required
cases.item: {derive} struct S { a: String, b: Option<String> }

cases.name: a doc comment is the description

descriptions.host: The host name. Written in DNS form.

cases.name: schema description wins over the doc comment
cases.item:
{derive} struct S { /// Ignored.
    #[schema(description = "Stated.", title = "Host")] host: String }

cases.name: a sensitive field
cases.item: {derive} struct S { user: String, #[schema(sensitive)] token: String }

cases.name: section order advanced read_only deprecated and bounds
cases.item: {derive} struct S { #[schema(section = "Network", order = 2, advanced, read_only, deprecated, min_length = 1, max_length = 8, pattern = "^a", format = "hostname")] name: String, #[schema(multiple_of = 5, min_items = 1, max_items = 2, examples("a".to_string()))] other: String }

cases.name: a flattened struct's keys sit beside the others
cases.item: {derive} struct Inner { x: u8 } {derive} struct S { a: u8, #[map(flatten)] inner: Inner }

cases.name: a transparent struct is its field
a variant's own rename and label

a tagged enum has arms

cases.name: rename_all names the arms
cases.item: {derive} #[map(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")] enum E { KeyFile { path: String }, NoAuth }

cases.name: a newtype arm holds a type whose keys sit beside the tag

with names a module that converts the field (a list of protocol names)
cases.item: mod alpn_list { use coqui_builder::describe::LeafError; pub const TYPE: &str = "AlpnList"; pub fn to_text(items: &[String]) -> String { items.join(",") } pub fn from_text(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, LeafError> { Ok(text.split(",").filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).map(String::from).collect()) } } {derive} struct S { #[map(default, with = alpn_list)] alpn: Vec<String> }
cases.coqui_item: mod alpn_list { use coqui_builder::describe::LeafError; pub const TYPE: &str = "AlpnList"; pub fn to_text(items: &[String]) -> String { items.join(",") } pub fn from_text(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, LeafError> { Ok(text.split(",").filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).map(String::from).collect()) } } {derive} struct S { #[map(default, with = alpn_list)] alpn: Vec<String> }
cases.guatiao_item: mod alpn_list { use guatiao::{Alloc, FromValue, MapError, Schema, ToValue, Value, ValueError}; use guatiao::schema::KindBuilder; pub fn to_value_in(items: &[String], alloc: Alloc) -> Result<Value, ValueError> { items.to_value_in(alloc) } pub fn from_value(value: &Value) -> Result<Vec<String>, MapError> { Vec::<String>::from_value(value) } pub fn kind(alloc: Alloc) -> KindBuilder { KindBuilder::list_in(alloc, String::kind(alloc)) } } {derive} struct S { #[map(default, with = alpn_list)] alpn: Vec<String> }

cases.name: with names a module that converts bytes held as text (a protocol name)
cases.item: mod alpn_text { use coqui_builder::describe::LeafError; pub const TYPE: &str = "Alpn"; pub fn to_text(alpn: &[u8]) -> String { String::from_utf8_lossy(alpn).into_owned() } pub fn from_text(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, LeafError> { Ok(text.as_bytes().to_vec()) } } {derive} struct S { #[map(default, with = alpn_text)] alpn: Vec<u8> }
cases.coqui_item: mod alpn_text { use coqui_builder::describe::LeafError; pub const TYPE: &str = "Alpn"; pub fn to_text(alpn: &[u8]) -> String { String::from_utf8_lossy(alpn).into_owned() } pub fn from_text(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, LeafError> { Ok(text.as_bytes().to_vec()) } } {derive} struct S { #[map(default, with = alpn_text)] alpn: Vec<u8> }
cases.guatiao_item: mod alpn_text { use guatiao::{Alloc, FromValue, MapError, Schema, ToValue, Value, ValueError}; use guatiao::schema::KindBuilder; pub fn to_value_in(alpn: &[u8], alloc: Alloc) -> Result<Value, ValueError> { String::from_utf8(alpn.to_vec()).map_err(|_| ValueError::Unrepresentable)?.to_value_in(alloc) } pub fn from_value(value: &Value) -> Result<Vec<u8>, MapError> { Ok(String::from_value(value)?.into_bytes()) } pub fn kind(alloc: Alloc) -> KindBuilder { String::kind(alloc) } } {derive} struct S { #[map(default, with = alpn_text)] alpn: Vec<u8> }
